title: KODEX — KDRIVE: RL-control
description:
KODEX — KDRIVE (RL-control). reinforcement-learning controller — a feedback policy learned by the cross-entropy method in the twin plant loop; clamped by KGATE

Benchmark: RL policy (cross-entropy): tracking **0.0551** vs naive 0.1225, twin-in-the-loop

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)).
